paragraphs: Revenue Solutions, Inc., known as RSI, builds tax, property, and revenue software for government agencies of all sizes. Its buyers are cities, counties, states, and federal departments, more than 60 public agencies across the United States.

The software sits on a single platform that the company describes as configurable systems built to meet the essential needs of government. The work involves modernizing legacy revenue and financial systems, identifying and preventing fraud, and improving citizen engagement. RSI also points to an open data model that it says gives an agency complete visibility and control over its own data.

The firm was founded in May 1996 in Massachusetts. It began by providing state tax staff augmentation before building products of its own. Among the agencies it names as customers are the U.S. IRS, the Multistate Tax Commission, and the Province of Saskatchewan. The company counts more than 300 completed projects. RSI was acquired by DC Capital Partners, joining a portfolio of government-focused companies.

quote.text: Our mission is to empower government offices to enhance citizen services, boost operational efficiency, and maximize revenue collection.
